title: af.warm-eviction/1
description: What the Storage Budget leaves beside a Warm Check Cache key it evicted, as `<project>/<toolchain>.evicted` (ADR-0207): who evicted it, when, and the bytes it held. The sweep evicts only a key no check holds; a check that nevertheless finds its key gone reports this record's cause, `layer evicted during build by storage sweep at <time>`, and a key gone without one as removed by another process.
